values.note: Three shower/flush-toilet buildings plus vault toilets and hand pumps; swim beach, amphitheater, paved boat ramp. Showers, water fill and the dump station shut down at the end of September, weather permitting.

values.note: recreation.gov takes reservations for 45 single sites (9-18, 20, 22, 24-26, 29, 31, 32, 34, 35, 40, 42-54, 66, 68, 81-89) and all group sites during the summer peak (2026: May 21 - Sept 7; 2027: May 27 - Sept 6), closing 4 days before arrival; the other sites, and every site in spring and fall, are first-come. The 2-night weekend minimum is marked soft on recreation.gov and may be relaxed for a same-day booking.

note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Lakewood-Laona District) around the south end of 362-acre Boulder Lake, the forest's largest campground. Sites 17-35 run along the shore behind a band of pines; the rest sit back in young hardwoods around a bog, with puddles and damp spots common. Swim beach, amphitheater and boardwalk trail. ATVs and UTVs are barred in the campground. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS read: 89 single sites (23 electric, 50 A on 40-54) + 10 group, $18/$28, 45 singles reservable in the summer peak with a 4-day cutoff, the rest first-come; showers, flush and vault toilets, dump. Lakeview confirmed (shore sites under pines). Max length 45 -> 53 (catalog). Pin ~660 m west of the sites. 2027 season 04-29..10-12 (manual season not overwritten).
flags: WATERFRONT: stored lakeview confirmed. Sites 17-35 (e.g. 24 at 45.14180,-88.63324; 25 at 45.14192,-88.63285; 26 at 45.14204,-88.63249) sit ~15-35 m from the lake but under a continuous band of pines along the shore on Esri imagery (rec.gov: 'located in a stand of young hardwoods, overlooking the lake. Shore sites are nightly (17, 18, 20, 22, 24-26, 29, 31, 32, 34, 35 reservable; 19, 21, 23, 27, 28, 30, 33 first-come).
